jobs.description: Tasks, salary, and working through Charlie works  30 September 2026 4 min read What exactly does a logistics worker do? Do you want to know what a logistics worker does before you start working in the Netherlands? In short, a logistics worker ensures that products end up in the right place. This starts with unloading trucks and ends with preparing orders for shipment. A lot happens in between: scanning, sorting, packing, and sometimes driving a pallet truck or forklift. The job is physical, varied, and very suitable if you enjoy working with your hands. You do not need a diploma, and basic English or Polish is often sufficient on the work floor. That is why this is a popular first job for migrant workers from Poland, Hungary, Slovakia, and Romania. What is a logistics worker? A logistics worker usually works in a warehouse or distribution center. You are part of a team that manages the flow of goods. Think of large centers for webshops, supermarkets, or transport companies. There are thousands of these types of locations in the Netherlands, especially around Venlo, Tilburg, Rotterdam, and Utrecht. The role is broad. One day you pick orders, the next you help in the packing department or check the stock. Do you want to know more about what such a location looks like from the inside? Then read our article about working in a distribution center in the Netherlands . The main tasks at a glance Tasks vary by company, but these are the most common activities: - Order picking : removing products from the shelves using a handheld scanner or voice-picking system. - Packing : preparing orders for shipment, including labels and shipping documents. - Loading and unloading : filling or emptying trucks, often with a pallet truck. - Checking stock : counting and registering whether everything in the system is correct. - Forklift driving : moving pallets (you need a certificate for this). - Sorting : distributing packages by destination or rout...
